end.summary:
Health was discussed as physical, mental and social well-being.
Siya identified body, mind and social connections as the three parts of health.
They explained that being free from illness alone does not mean complete health.
They applied the idea to examples involving sleep, worry, sadness and isolation.
Teach-back responses were correct on two unaided attempts.
end.parentNote: Siya practised explaining health through the body, mind and social parts, using student examples and comparing different situations. They clearly connected poor sleep, worry and isolation with health, not only illness. No factual mix-up was noted; early uncertainty about the examples was clarified during the discussion. At home, ask Siya to name the three parts of health and give one everyday example for each.
